gui: Computer Use through explicit isolated app paths; native Open/Save/Window/Quit controls, real key input and screenshot inspection

before.note: The intermediate reading-only fix still allowed the default HTML dialog Escape cancellation to bubble through WebKit doneWithKeyEvent / _web_superKeyDown / NSWindow keyDown / noResponderFor:keyDown.

paragraph typing, Escape, repeated Escape, Command-S
Find typing and Escape closes the native search field
reentry and Undo restore the saved original; Command-S persists it
second document opened, reading Escape, Window menu switch to first document
close and reopen the saved first document
empty about:blank document reading Escape, click editing, Escape, repeated Escape and clean close

limits: No audio loopback recording: suppression verified by observing the previously reproduced AppKit noResponderFor:keyDown warning-sound path, with behavior left intact by the probe.
